waves.warningText: Humans and Monsters From Middle and Farm
Humans and Monsters From Middle and Farm

resources.assets:6454.name: E Fire Snail
resources.assets:6454.description: A slow monster bound by dark forces that explodes on death. Takes reduced damage from fire and explosions.

resources.assets:6453.name: E Flail
resources.assets:6453.description: Deals splash damage with each attack.

resources.assets:6468.name: E Flogre
resources.assets:6468.description: A giant ogre equipped with a flail, dealing splash damage around it.

resources.assets:6459.name: E Racer
resources.assets:6459.description: Racers are fast rolling monsters that are not messing around. They aim right for your castle center and are somewhat armored against attacks from the player character.

resources.assets:5072.name: E Ram
resources.assets:5072.description: Rams are siege units with a ton of health looking to tear down your walls and buildings. Furthermore, they are armored against ranged attacks.

resources.assets:6458.name: E Hunterling
resources.assets:6458.description: Hunterlings are incredibly fast and dangerous monsters with the sole aim of chasing you down. They can smell your royal blood all across the entire kingdom.

resources.assets:6472.name: E Thing
resources.assets:6472.description: A terrifying monster that can attack with its tentacles in all directions at once.

resources.assets:5077.name: E Quicksling
resources.assets:5077.description: A unique siege weapon that rapidly fires arrows at random enemies in its range. If you don't have any allied buildings or units nearby, it will quickly mow you down.

resources.assets:6470.name: E Exploder
resources.assets:6470.description: Exploders are monsters that roll straight for the closest building and explode when they die. They are slightly armored against attacks from the player character.

resources.assets:5076.name: E Catapult
resources.assets:5076.description: Catapults are siege units that deal massive damage to your buildings from afar. Your only chance is to get close and destroy them before they demolish your walls.

resources.assets:5068.name: E Archer
resources.assets:5068.description: Archers shoot arrows from afar. Quite strong when left uncontested. Weak against buildings and towers.

resources.assets:6467.name: E BarrelKnight
resources.assets:6467.description: An enchanted warrior made of wood. Counts as a siege weapon and is armored against ranged attacks. Quite sturdy and eager to cause trouble.

resources.assets:6446.name: E Moleman
resources.assets:6446.description: Can tunnel directly to its target. Takes additional damage from defense towers.

resources.assets:6465.name: E Ghost
resources.assets:6465.description: Can pass through other units and closed gates. Prefers to attack towers and your castle center. Takes increased damage from towers but reduced damage from your character.

resources.assets:5069.name: E Flyer
resources.assets:5069.description: Wasps are flying monsters eager to destroy every single one of your economic buildings.
